IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO.1274/2025
ANIL PARASNATH BHAGAT ...APPLICANT
VS
STATE OF MAHARASHTRA ...RESPONDENT
…
Adv. Omkar S. Mayekar a/w Disha P . Chaurasia, Mangesh Shinde & 
Aditya Mandavkar for the Applicant.  
Adv. Nitin B. Patil, APP for the Respondent State.
PI Jaymala Vasave, Kasturba Marg Police Station. 
…
CORAM : RAJESH S. PATIL, J.  
DATED : MAY 6, 2025
P .C.:
1. The learned APP submits that, in the present FIR, Section
75 of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Section 67 of the Information
Technology Act, 2000 have been implicated. Therefore, the victim lady
needs to be added as party respondent no.2.
2. The applicant is directed to add the victim lady as party
respondent no. 2 in the present proceedings. Amendment to be carried
out  forthwith. If  the  amendment  is  not  carried  out  forthwith,  the
anticipatory  bail  application  will  stand  dismissed  without  further
reference to this Court.
3. Issue notice to respondent no. 2 returnable on 9 May 2025.
1
Harish

914-ABA-1274-2025.doc
4. The learned APP to serve a copy of the anticipatory bail
application on the respondent no.2 through the investigating officer.
5. Stand over to 9 May 2025.
(RAJESH S. PATIL, J.)
2
Harish
